category_definitions.i: numerical constant already compared against an independent computation
category_definitions.ii: numerical constant NOT yet compared before this run
category_definitions.iv: arrays of per-world / per-channel / per-draw data

constant_table.name: world1_eps[0]
constant_table.method: declared input; interval endpoint definition of material interval I_i

constant_table.name: world2_eps[0]
constant_table.method: Solve q(eps2,x)=c*q(eps1,x), c=q2_supplied/q1_supplied, dps=50 Newton

constant_table.name: world1_eps[1]
constant_table.method: declared input; interval endpoint definition of material interval I_i

constant_table.name: world2_eps[1]
constant_table.method: Solve q(eps2,x)=c*q(eps1,x), c=q2_supplied/q1_supplied, dps=50 Newton

constant_table.name: world1_q[0] (x=0.2)
constant_table.method: A5 s8 reactance q from mie_reactance.mp_q (same arrangement as code/mie_reactance), dps=50

constant_table.name: world2_q[0] (x=0.2)
constant_table.method: A5 s8 reactance q from mie_reactance.mp_q, dps=50

constant_table.name: world1_q[1] (x=0.15)
constant_table.method: A5 s8 reactance q from mie_reactance.mp_q (same arrangement as code/mie_reactance), dps=50

constant_table.name: world2_q[1] (x=0.15)
constant_table.method: A5 s8 reactance q from mie_reactance.mp_q, dps=50

constant_table.name: gain1
constant_table.method: declared reference gain; |g|=1 lies inside gain_allowed_modulus

constant_table.name: gain2 = gain1/c (c=q2/q1)
constant_table.method: s5 two-world compensation g' = g/c with c = q2/q1 = 1.25 (dps=50)

constant_table.name: gain_allowed_modulus[0]
constant_table.method: declared gain annulus; containment checked for |gain1|=1 and |gain2|=0.8
constant_table.note: declared domain constant, not an independently derivable number

constant_table.name: gain_allowed_modulus[1]
constant_table.method: declared gain annulus (upper); equals the s5 scale c=1.25

constant_table.name: reference_scalar_real_standard_deviation
constant_table.method: declared real-reference std (used in s7 union bound)
constant_table.note: declared input; the derived companion 0.0032905... is checked below

constant_table.name: reference_error_bound = sigma_a*Phi^{-1}(0.9995)
constant_table.method: sigma_a * inverse normal CDF at 0.9995 = 0.001*3.2905267314918948, mpmath dps=50

constant_table.name: complex_noise_sigma[0]
constant_table.method: 0.002*|g1*t1(eps1_i,x_i)| with t=iq/(1-iq) computed from the dps=50 reactance

constant_table.name: complex_noise_sigma[1]
constant_table.method: 0.002*|g1*t1(eps1_i,x_i)| with t=iq/(1-iq) computed from the dps=50 reactance

constant_table.name: complex_whitened_distance
constant_table.method: whitened two-channel mean gap D = sqrt(sum |d_mu_i|^2 / sigma_i^2), dps=50

constant_table.name: no_reference_equal_prior_optimal_error
constant_table.method: p_* = erfc(D/2)/2 (proper-complex binary risk, s6), dps=50

constant_table.name: modal_error_bounds[0]
constant_table.method: b_i = sigma_i*sqrt(log 1000) (per-channel noise envelope, s7), dps=50

constant_table.name: modal_error_bounds[1]
constant_table.method: b_i = sigma_i*sqrt(log 1000) (per-channel noise envelope, s7), dps=50

constant_table.name: monotonicity_checks[0].q_lower
constant_table.method: iv.dps=35 interval sweep, min over boxes of the q lower endpoint (left-endpoint box)
constant_table.note: reproduces only because both codes share the same loose q/Den enclosure

constant_table.name: monotonicity_checks[0].q_upper
constant_table.method: iv.dps=35 interval sweep, max over boxes of the q upper endpoint

constant_table.name: monotonicity_checks[0].denominator_lower

constant_table.name: monotonicity_checks[0].qprime_upper
constant_table.method: iv.dps=35 interval sweep, max over boxes of the q' upper endpoint
constant_table.note: supplied value is tighter than this implementation's enclosure: it lies between the pointwise maximum at eps_lo and this interval upper bound, so it is a valid but differently-grouped enclosure, not bit-reproducible here

constant_table.method: iv.dps=35 interval sweep, min over boxes of the q' lower endpoint
constant_table.note: known-not-bit-reproducible: the producer's q' enclosure is tighter than any variant tried in increment 2 (V1..V7)

constant_table.name: relative_data_difference
constant_table.method: candidate (b) Euclidean norm over the two channels: ||d_mu||_2/||mu||_2, dps=50; winner test (b) ||d_mu||_2/||mu||_2

constant_table.name: exact_reactance_identity_error
constant_table.method: NOT IDENTIFIED: none of identities (a)-(d) at dps=15,20,25,30,35,50 or float64 lands within 20% over the four world points; nearest is identity (a) in float64 at the two world-2 points, 2.17e-19 = 2.44x the target
constant_table.note: extra probe: at dps=17 the residual |(1-iq)t - iq| over a 36-point (eps,x) grid gives 7.97e-20 (0.90x) and |Re t+|t|^2| gives 1.084e-19 (1.22x); dps=17 is outside the required precision set and the 36-point grid is a guess, so this is not conclusive

constant_table.name: finite_material_distance
constant_table.method: Euclidean distance ||eps2 - eps1||_2 over the two material channels, dps=50
